tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search every offer by spec, price and place. Returns rows, how the sentence was understood, and facet counts for narrowing. Prices carry the billed amount and an estimated USD per month.

tools.name: cheapest
tools.description: The lowest priced rows that meet the given minimums, ranked by estimated monthly USD.

tools.name: parse_query
tools.description: See how a sentence would be read, without running it.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: One offer by id with its provider, price history and similar offers.

tools.name: compare_servers
tools.description: Up to 20 offers side by side.

tools.name: facets
tools.description: Every facet value with its count, under an optional filter set.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Hosting providers with their automation (api, cli, terraform, mcp), country, categories and runtimes. Filter with has, country, category, runtime, q.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: A provider by slug or domain, with every offer it sells here.

tools.name: deals
tools.description: Current hosting deals and industry stories.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Counts of servers, providers, countries, GPU offers and the last sync.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Save a filter set under a name on the caller’s account.

tools.name: saved_searches
tools.description: The caller’s saved searches, each with its URL, curl and CLI form.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Remove one saved search by id.

tools.name: redeem_code
tools.description: Redeem a credit code (CR-…) on the caller’s account for days of the pass: no hourly allowance and 500 rows a page on every key, the CLI and MCP while it runs.

tools.name: list_invites
tools.description: The caller’s invites (quota, status of each) and open affiliate link. Invites are scarce and single use.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Make one invite link from the caller’s quota. The link is returned once; both sides get days of the pass when a new account is made from it.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: The caller’s webhook endpoints (url, event filters, on/off, failures) and the event types r4ck sends: server.listed and server.price_dropped for offers matching a saved search, pass.granted, api_key.created, api_key.revoked.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register an https URL to receive the caller’s events as signed POSTs (CloudEvents body, Standard Webhooks headers). Returns the endpoint and its signing secret (whsec_…), shown once.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Change an endpoint’s url, events or description, or switch it on/off (switching on clears its failure count).

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete an endpoint and its delivery log.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a signed webhook.test event to the endpoint now and report the HTTP status.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Mint a new signing secret and return it; the old one stops working at once.

tools.name: webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Recent deliveries (status, attempts, last HTTP status or error, payload), for one endpoint or all.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_webhooks, create_webhook · Private data: create_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, webhook_deliveries · Destructive: delete_saved_search, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_webhooks, create_webhook · Private data: create_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, webhook_deliveries · Destructive: delete_saved_search, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
